dedupe_keys.name: elmas hourly electrical load profiles of 424 french industrial and tertiary sectors 2018

description: ELMAS is an open set of 18 hourly electricity load profiles for industrial and tertiary sectors in France over the year 2018, produced by MINES Paris (Centre PERSEE) for Enedis, the main French distribution system operator, which commissioned the work for its planning tools. The profiles are derived from hourly consumption series of 55,730 customers split into 424 business sectors by NACE code and three levels of subscribed capacity; series were averaged by class for anonymity, grouped into 18 clusters by K-means with a manual reassignment, and weighted using Enedis annual consumption for about 4.5 million customers in 2019. The Figshare record, published on 3 September 2023, holds a data zip and a package zip with R analysis scripts; profiles are standardised, with means, standard deviations, annual energy and building surface areas per class for rescaling. Coverage is France, one year. Files are free to download under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the panel of 55,730 customers may be biased against the national population, only one year is covered, and the clustering code is not published. Simulation uses are non-residential demand at substations and feeders in distribution planning and electrification scenarios. Related records: data-goiener-smart-meter-data-spain covers Spanish supply points.
